Story
Discover the Naruto story with questions prepared for you.
Challenge
In the shinobi world, there is no room for mistakes!
Classic
Time to test your general knowledge.
Akatsuki
Our mission is to destroy false peace.
Clan
Remember your origin, protect your clan.
Tailed Beast
This is the world of beasts.
Teams
In the shinobi world, those who break the rules are scum, that’s true. But those who abandon their friends are worse than scum!
Who learned the Shadow Clone Technique from the Forbidden Scroll on the night of the Mizuki incident?
Which student received Iruka’s own forehead protector as a gift?
Who defeated Neji in the Chūnin Exams and stood against the idea of “fate”?
Who opened the door to change by defeating Gaara in their first major clash?
Who learned Sage Mode at Mount Myōboku after Jiraiya’s death?
Who saved the village during Pain’s assault on Konoha and persuaded Nagato?
Who pulled Might Guy back from death after he opened the Eighth Gate?
Who received the power of the Six Paths from Hagoromo?
Which little boy got his first free bowl of ramen at the Ichiraku stand?
Who was the orphan sitting alone on the swing behind the school?
Who was shaken by the question “what does a ninja fight for?” on the Zabuza–Haku mission?
Who taught Konohamaru the Rasengan?
Who convinced Tsunade to accept becoming Hokage?
Which shinobi stopped Nagato together with Edo Itachi?
Who stood back up after seeing Hinata following the Asura Path’s spiked attack?
In Kaguya’s dimension, who struck the sealing blow in perfect sync with Sasuke?
After losing Jiraiya, who set his master’s definition of a “true hero” as his goal?
On the bridge in the Land of Waves, who threw himself in front of Haku’s senbon to save a teammate?
Who received Orochimaru’s Cursed Seal during the Forest of Death stage?
Who brought Chidori into the arena for the first time in the Chūnin Exam finals to pierce Gaara’s sand?
Who escaped Deidara’s C0 self-destruction by summoning Manda and paying the price?
Who formed Hebi and later Taka, setting out to face his single target—his brother?
Who turned thunder into “Kirin,” changing the course of the Uchiha brothers’ duel?
After learning the truth, who crashed the Five Kage Summit and ended Danzō’s rule?
Who revived Orochimaru and had the Edo Hokage summoned to question the past directly?
When the war ended, who chose to be a watcher in the shadows instead of taking a seat in the village?
Who walked the path of snakes in youth, then switched his contract to the “Hawk Summon”?
In the battle against Kinshiki and Momoshiki, who built coordinated combos shoulder to shoulder with Naruto?
Within the ice mirrors against Haku, who reached the threshold that awakened his Sharingan?
Who trapped Kakashi in a three-day torture time with Tsukuyomi?
Who bore the “cycle of hatred” and protected Konoha from the shadows?
Who ruined Orochimaru’s body-snatching plan in a single move and made him quit Akatsuki?
Who safeguarded Shisui’s eye and protected Kotoamatsukami?
Who undertook the unseen double-agent mission against his own clan to prevent a coup in Konoha?
In their final encounter, who bid farewell by touching his two fingers to his brother’s forehead?
Who neutralized Kirin by lowering Susanoo’s Yata Mirror onto it?
Who instantly sealed the Orochimaru that surfaced within his brother using the Totsuka Blade?
While reanimated, who trapped Kabuto in the Izanami loop and forced him to end Edo Tensei?
Which ANBU-born shinobi covertly fed Akatsuki intel back to Konoha?
In the fight with Nagato, who used the Totsuka Blade to save Naruto and Killer B?
Who awakened his Mangekyō Sharingan after Shisui’s death?
Who became an ANBU captain at 13 and pursued the idea of a peace that would end war?
After his death, who opened the path to stop his brother’s vision loss with his eyes?
Who negotiated with Konoha’s leaders and made Sasuke’s life a condition on the night of the coup?
Even after leaving the village, who kept watching threats from the shadows to continue protecting Konoha?
While reincarnated, who told his brother “I will always love you”?
In Naruto and Sasuke’s Final Valley battle, the single hand that appears in Sasuke’s palm—whose hand is it?
During Team 7’s bell test, who taught the balance of “rules or the team” and the lesson of sharing lunch?
Who earned the nickname “Copy Ninja” by copying over a thousand jutsu?
On the Kannabi Bridge mission, who received the Sharingan in his left eye per his friend’s last wish?
Who developed the Chidori/Raikiri technique and first used it in battle?
Who first applied Kamui to a live target to stop Deidara’s escape?
Who lost his life during Pain’s attack—the one whose death Naruto sensed?
Who took the seat of the Sixth Hokage after the war?
Which master keeps his “Icha Icha” book in hand even mid-battle?
Who returned to the village in a Sukea disguise, hiding even his face while investigating?
Who founded Konoha together with Hashirama, only for their destinies to split later?
Who dropped two meteors in a single move, breaking the balance of the war?
Who subdued all Five Kage alone, displaying overwhelming power?
Who bound opponents simultaneously with invisible “Limbo” shadows?
Who awakened the Rinnegan using Hashirama’s cells and advanced the ultimate plan?
Who became the Ten-Tails’ jinchūriki and attained Six Paths power?
Who cast the Infinite Tsukuyomi across the world via the moon’s reflection?
Who unleashed a Perfect Susanoo that could slice mountains?
When the Eighth Gate opened, who honored his foe by saying “the strongest taijutsu I’ve ever seen”?
Who said “Heroes arrive late,” went under the rubble to save a friend, and entrusted his eye?
Who, behind the mask, orchestrated the attack on Konoha as “the Masked Man”?
Who played dumb in Akatsuki under the role of “Tobi”?
Who used Kamui to dematerialize his body and pass through attacks?
After Rin’s death, who locked the world onto his “Eye of the Moon Plan”?
Who settled old bonds by dueling Kakashi alone across dimensions?
Who pulled Naruto out of a fatal moment, taking his first step toward atonement?
Who secretly led Akatsuki from the shadows and ignited the war?
In his final moment, who remembered his true self and passed on his power for the ninjas’ future?
As a child, who was involuntarily protected by a sand shield and condemned to loneliness?
In the Chūnin Exams, who was shaken for the first time when even his defense was pierced by Rock Lee?
Whose heart changed after hearing Naruto’s words about sharing the same pain of loneliness?
Who became Sunagakure’s youngest Kazekage to protect his village?
Who fought at the cost of his life to protect his village against Deidara?
Whose Tailed Beast was extracted, only to be brought back to life by Chiyo’s sacrifice?
At the Five Kage Summit, whose voice defended Naruto against the Raikage?
Who delivered the unifying commander’s speech to the Allied Shinobi Forces?
Who faced his father Rasa’s spirit in the war and healed the wounds of his past?
In the Fourth Great Ninja War, who learned from Rasa that the sand protecting him was actually his mother’s love?
During a childhood assassination attempt, whose sand rose by itself to shield him—thanks to his mother’s will?
Who was taken from the Konoha Orphanage and became Orochimaru’s most secret spy?
Who perfected Edo Tensei and raised the pieces of war from their graves?
Who reached Sage Mode in Ryūchi Cave and shook the arena with “White Rage”?
Who learned self-acceptance within Izanami’s loop and broke the chain?
Who returned to the orphanage after the war and set out on a new path?
Who, as one of the Legendary Sannin, pursued immortality through forbidden experiments?
Who left the Cursed Seal on Sasuke during the Forest of Death?
Who summoned the Edo Hokage during the Konoha Crush to settle things with his master?
Who slipped death by shedding his snake body like a cast-off skin?
At Sasuke’s request, who returned and once again summoned the Edo Hokage to open the gates of history?
In the Chūnin Exams, who dropped his training weights and blanketed the arena in dust with his speed?
Against Gaara, who opened the first gate and made hearts race with the Initial Lotus?
In the Forest of Death, who stood alone in front of the Sound trio to protect Sakura?
Who lay on Tsunade’s operating table to fight again despite the risk of dying from surgery?
Who bamboozled Kimimaro—even if only for a moment—with the jittery “Drunken Fist”?
In the Forest of Death, who cut her own hair and declared, “I’ll fight too now”?
Who trained under Tsunade as a medical-ninja and gained the strength to crack the ground with a single punch?
Who defeated Akatsuki’s Sasori fighting shoulder to shoulder with Chiyo?
When Naruto’s heart was about to stop, who pumped it with her bare hands and brought him back?
Who released the seal on her forehead and healed thousands on the front lines at once with the Strength of a Hundred?
As the “Yellow Flash of Konoha,” whose speed ended battles before the medics even arrived?
On the night the village was attacked, who warped the Nine-Tails’ massive Tailed Beast Bomb away from Konoha with the Flying Thunder God Technique?
Who sacrificed himself to stop Kurama torn from Kushina and entrusted the seal to his son?
Who, inspired by the hero of Jiraiya’s novel, named his son “Naruto” and entrusted him to his godfather?
Who outpaced even Raikage A and turned the battlefield inside out in a flash with the “Flying Thunder God”?
With no special bloodline of his own, who defeated his pupil—wielding the Nine-Tails—entirely on his own?
